settings.intro:
Every piece here was written, drawn or filmed by a real Aussie kid and published in theINmag. Nothing polished up, nothing generated, no fake bylines.

Read them for fun, or use them in your classroom as mentor texts your students can actually measure themselves against. New pieces land with every issue.
settings.cta_copy: theINmag publishes real kids in print, three times a year. Send IN their creation and it could be on these pages next.
